verdict.rationale: Airwallex's docs cover the core pillars of a consolidated platform: multi-currency cards/spend controls, card expense sync to ERP, bill pay/AP via Bills API, global transfers/batch payouts, FX conversion, and banking-as-a-service style global accounts for holding/receiving funds — directly matching spend, bill pay, and banking consolidation. Missing for 10: independent/third-party case studies or reviews confirming founders actually replaced multiple point solutions with Airwallex in practice, and clearer unified UI/dashboard evidence tying these APIs into one seamless product experience.
